title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Trio #22 (동심원 3구역·매끈 / 가로 띠 3구역·매끈 / 세로 띠 3구역·물결)

Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare.
